issues.description: The problem statement shows simulate_msd_two_rounds with batch_size typed/defaulted as a float (batch_size: float = 1000000.0), while both the template and solution define simulate_msd_two_rounds with batch_size as an int default (batch_size: int = 1000000). This minor type/default mismatch in the specification vs code may confuse students about the intended parameter type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the batch_size parameter consistent across artifacts. Prefer using an integer batch size in the problem statement (e.g., batch_size: int = 1000000) to match the template and solution, or change the template/solution defaults to float if a float is truly required.
